title: Shared the Mall Dream on Reddit… Now I’m Waking Up in a Mansion. By Water. With Eyes on Me.
content: I used to have a recurring lucid dream centered around The Mall—a dream space so vivid and layered, it never felt like “just a dream.” Like many of you, I shared this experience on Reddit, and shortly after doing so… the dream changed. It’s no longer the mall. Now, I find myself already inside a mansion. I don’t arrive there—I’m just already there, as if I’ve always belonged to it or been stationed in it. I don’t remember the world around the mansion. No roads, no neighborhoods, no origin story. Just this enormous home—and I know it’s mine. The mansion always sits near a large body of water, but the body of water changes: Sometimes it’s a massive lake—calm, glassy, eerie in its stillness. Other times, it’s the ocean—endless and deep, with a shifting horizon. The color of the water seems to dictate the tone of the dream… blue-green when it's expansive and liberating, dark gray when I feel watched. Last night, the fragments were clear: I was in a room full of people, casually talking, but I wasn’t part of the conversation. Then, they looked at me—not like I was interrupting, but like they suddenly realized I was there. It wasn’t hostile, but it wasn’t passive either. Just that unmistakable shift in awareness when you know you’ve been seen in a place you weren’t meant to be fully awake in. It felt like a psychic shift more than a dream change. Like sharing The Mall publicly disrupted the old loop, and now I’ve been moved or promoted—or maybe marked. I’m sharing this because I know I’m not the only one. If your dreamscapes have changed since sharing or recalling them publicly… If you’ve found yourself inside mansions, old hotels, schools that feel familiar but wrong, or surrounded by people who notice you too clearly… Please speak up. I think we’ve crossed into the next layer.
